name: Marabou
run: vehicle compile queries -s spec.vcl -f MarabouQueries -o Marabou.queries/ --network f:fake.onnx

name: DL2Loss
run: vehicle compile loss -s spec.vcl -l DL2Loss -o DL2Loss.vcl

name: TestVerify
run: vehicle verify -s spec.vcl -v testVerifier --network f:fake.onnx --property underConstrainedVars --solver-args='sat 'f_X[0]=10,f_Y[0]=3.0''
